prompt: A cinematic, high-resolution digital painting of a Dunhuang Flying Apsara (Feitian) playing a Pipa lute at night. The central figure is an elegant young woman with fair skin and delicate features, eyes closed in serene concentration. She wears an elaborate silver and white celestial gown with intricate floral embroidery and sheer, flowing blue ribbons that swirl dynamically around her body, creating a sense of weightlessness. Her hair is styled in a complex traditional updo adorned with a jeweled silver crown featuring dangling pearl tassels and a glowing halo effect behind her head. She holds a wooden Pipa vertically, fingers positioned on the strings. The background depicts a mystical fusion of ancient cave temples carved into rocky cliffs on the right, illuminated by warm golden candlelight, contrasting with the cool moonlit atmosphere. In the lower right foreground, a tranquil lotus pond glows with white blooming lotuses and floating lanterns. A large, bright full moon hangs in the dark blue starry sky above the cliffs. The lighting is soft and ethereal, utilizing a 'Pro-Mist' effect where moonlight creates a creamy bloom and rim light highlights the edges of her hair and ribbons. The overall color palette balances icy blues and silvers with warm golds and browns.
